description: This file defines a C# record named SiloMetadata within the Orleans runtime membership service namespace. It contains properties and methods related to silo metadata management, including an immutable dictionary to store metadata entries and methods to add metadata items.

classes.name: SiloMetadata
classes.description: A record that encapsulates silo metadata as an immutable dictionary, with methods to add metadata entries.

methods.name: AddMetadata(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string>> metadata)
methods.description: Adds multiple metadata entries to the existing metadata dictionary.

methods.name: AddMetadata(string key, string value)
methods.description: Adds a single metadata entry to the existing metadata dictionary.
